title: Danny Jones interview throttled over a mention of mission control technology

tellings.quote: that was me mentioning about some technology at mission control

plain: In 2025, an interview Chris Bledsoe gave to the podcaster Danny Jones had its reach held back because he talked about some technology at NASA's Mission Control, Bledsoe says. Bledsoe, a man NASA is said to study because UFOs seem to appear around him, tells it about his own interview, as a sign that someone did not want that subject aired.
